Uses of Interface
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ProtocolChainCustomizer

Packages that use ProtocolChainCustomizer
Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web
Web adapter of the authorization server: security filter chains, login page and OpenAPI description.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth
Client authentication at the token endpoints beyond a shared secret: private_key_jwt with replay protection (RFC 7523) and mutual TLS, tls_client_auth and self_signed_tls_client_auth (RFC 8705).
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clients
Web adapter of registered client management: the administration endpoints, their DTOs, the startup seeding and the optional dynamic client registration.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.consent
 
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit
OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) for input-constrained clients, such as a command line tool: the protocol customizer that wires the device authorization and verification endpoints, the guard that applies the multi-factor policy and the limit on the attempts to the verification endpoint, and the verification page.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa
Multi-factor authentication orchestration.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.par
Pushed authorization requests (RFC 9126), opt-in with authserver.par.enabled: the protocol chain customizer that enables the framework's pushed authorization request endpoint.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.tokens
Token customization (claims, formats, lifetimes): the claims extension point, the access-token customizer, the UserInfo mapper and the expired authorization cleanup job.

    ClientAuthProtocolChainCustomizer
    Installs private_key_jwt with replay protection and the mutual-TLS client authentication in the protocol chain: the framework's assertion provider decodes with RegisteredJwksClientAssertionDecoderFactory, and its certificate provider verifies with ClientCertificateVerifier.

    MfaProtocolChainCustomizer
    Applies the multi-factor policy to /oauth2/authorize: a user whose client or account requires a second factor and has not presented one is sent to the second-factor page, with the authorize request saved, before any code is issued.
